hypotheses: Rename via the original DELETE-capable file handle with FILE_RENAME_INFO.ReplaceIfExists=false should preserve native volume/fileID across same-volume custody and restore, while existing target or source alias refuses rather than copies/overwrites.

Original parent chain and task-private target parent must remain pinned, source file is single-link/non-reparse with only unnamed data stream; bytes and original handle identity are rechecked before and after each move. Native error/timeout does not erase the retained location.

This is a generic low-level single-file mechanism only. Full SD, durable pre-move intent/current-ref CAS, directory/root custody, recovery and ClosedEligibility remain independent and unimplemented. No production capture/Start call is enabled.
independentChecks: destination occupied preserves both sides; explicit continue after task removes its own sentinel
